_readme.what: Velogames Fantasy Cycling Vuelta a España full-field data, 2023-2025.

game_rules.note: Confirmed from each edition's rules.php. Identical to the Tour de France game.

derived_fields.hindsight_optimum: Exact ILP over final points under the real squad constraints.
derived_fields.stage_type: ITT/TTT from Velogames' own stage labels. Others empirical: sprint = sprinters took >=40% of stage-result points, mountain = climbers + all-rounders took >=65%, else mixed. Describes who scored, not the official parcours. 'no_result' = stage run but neutralised or abandoned, no stage points awarded (Vuelta 2025 stages 11 and 21).
derived_fields.winning_score: Top score on the public Classic (Main) leaderboard, which shows the top ~300 teams only.

_readme.not_available: Velogames has purged rider data for editions before 2023; riders.php returns an empty table.
_readme.companion_csvs: Flattened and merged with the other grand tours into ../data/ (riders.csv, scores.csv, stages.csv, editions.csv, optimal_teams.csv, velogames.db) by ../scripts/build.py. The 'sum' column is named 'smt' there so it is safe as a SQL column name.
